dct_title_s: Satellite detected waters extents, as of 28 August 2019 over Sennar State, Sudan
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20190815SDN** This map illustrates satellite-detected surface water in Sennar State, Sudan as observed from SPOT-6 imagery acquired on 28 August 2019. Within the analysed extent of about 700 km2, a total about 23 km2 of lands appear to be flooded as of 28 August 2019. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR-UNOSAT.
